specialty_focus: Nahdi Medical Company is a publicly traded company on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) . Its major stakeholders include the founder Abdullah Amer Al-Nahdi (via the Al-Nahdi Family Office / Dan Company) and SEDCO Holding (Saudi Economic and Development Holding Company) , alongside public retail and institutional shareholders. Ownership Breakdown Public Shareholders: Following its 2022 IPO on the Saudi Exchange , a significant portion of Nahdi shares are publicly traded.
